questions.text: What is the dual function of temporal displacement in Bhisham Sahni’s “Do Aakhri Din” according to the lesson?

options.label: A
options.text: To create aesthetic novelty and mimic European modernist techniques.

options.label: B
options.text: To expose the inadequacy of official historiography and to force the reader to experience the protagonist’s fractured identity viscerally.

options.label: C
options.text: To linearise the narrative and clarify historical chronology.

options.label: D
options.text: To reinforce omniscient narration and provide a unified perspective.

questions.solution: Correct answer: To expose the inadequacy of official historiography and to force the reader to experience the protagonist’s fractured identity viscerally..

questions.text: Which of the following best describes the core theoretical disagreement within the Pragatishila movement regarding literary form in the 1940s–1950s?

options.label: A
options.text: Whether to adopt Sanskritised vocabulary or colloquial Kannada for mass communication.

options.label: B
options.text: Whether social commitment required accessible realist prose-poetry (gadyakavya) or permitted formal innovation like free verse to address modern alienation.

options.label: C
options.text: Whether to align with the Communist Party of India's cultural directives or maintain artistic autonomy from political parties.

options.label: D
options.text: Whether to focus on feudal exploitation in rural settings or industrial labour in urban centres as the primary subject matter.

questions.solution: Correct answer: Whether social commitment required accessible realist prose-poetry (gadyakavya) or permitted formal innovation like free verse to address modern alienation..

questions.text: The lesson outlines three competing periodizations for Santali literary history. When answering a question on periodization, what does the examiner expect?

questions.solution: Correct answer: To name the three periodizations (colonial, nationalist, indigenous) and choose one explicitly with justification.

questions.text: Which of the following accurately describes one of the three measurable effects of the shift from oral to print modernity in Punjabi poetry as discussed in the lesson?

options.text: The complete elimination of performative variation in favour of textual fidelity across all Punjabi literary forms

options.label: B
options.text: The canonisation of particular recensions, exemplified by the 1912 edition of Heer edited by Gurbakhsh Singh becoming the reference text for examinations

options.text: The immediate replacement of the dhadi tradition by Victorian aesthetic categories among all Punjabi readerships

options.label: D

questions.solution: Correct answer: The canonisation of particular recensions, exemplified by the 1912 edition of Heer edited by Gurbakhsh Singh becoming the reference text for examinations.

questions.text: Which narrative strategy distinguishes Rahman Rahi's polyphonic narration in his post-1947 modernist prose from a linguistically homogeneous reading?

questions.text: As per the table below showing Budget Estimates (BE) 2024-25 for Major Subsidies (in Rs Lakh Crore), what is the approximate percentage share of Food Subsidy in the total Major Subsidies? | Subsidy Type | Allocation (Rs Lakh Crore) | | :--- | :--- | | Food Subsidy | 2.05 | | Fertilizer Subsidy | 1.64 | | Petroleum Subsidy | 0.12 | | **Total Major Subsidies** | **3.81** |
questions.solution: Shortcut: Approximate the fraction 2.05/3.81. Round to 2.0/3.8 = 20/38 = 10/19. Since 10/20 = 50%, and denominator is slightly smaller (19), the value is slightly above 50%. Only 54% fits. Step-by-step: Total Major Subsidies = 3.81 Lakh Cr. Food Subsidy = 2.05 Lakh Cr. Percentage = (2.05 / 3.81) * 100. Calculate 2.05/3.81 ≈ 0.538. 0.538 * 100 = 53.8% ≈ 54%.
